meta.title: Life at Viewnear: careers in Monterrey & Austin
meta.description: Outcome-led, AI-native, team-powered: how we work at Viewnear, what we stand for, and the benefits behind it, from healthcare to emotional wellness.

hero.title: Building the <hl>data & AI home team</hl> for the Americas.
hero.description: Viewnear is outcome-led, AI-native, and built around one team that shares in every win. Here's how we work, what we stand for, and the benefits behind it.

offices.title: Two homes. One team.
offices.intro: We work from Austin and Monterrey, two offices that anchor a team spread across the Americas, in person and remote-augmented.

offices.deliveryCenterTitle: The Monterrey office is also our nearshore delivery center.

whereWeWork.title: Two hubs for coming together, flexibility for everything else.
whereWeWork.body: Inside, our offices are made for focus and for coming together: quiet corners for deep work, open lounges for the conversations that move projects forward. We gather in person because shared time builds the trust and alignment behind every outcome, and we stay flexible so life and great work can coexist.
bullets: Flexible, modern offices designed for focus and collaboration
In-person collaboration, extended by remote flexibility
Regular time together: retreats, Snowflake events, and team dinners
whereWeWork.imageAlt: Inside Viewnear's Monterrey office: an open lounge and work area with sofas, plants, a café bar, and wood-lined meeting rooms

model.title: Outcome-led. AI-native. Team-powered.
model.intro: We deliver outcomes, expand leverage through AI-native execution, and operate as one team with shared accountability.

items.title: Outcomes first
items.body: We organize our work around measurable business outcomes, not activity. Success is defined by client impact, quality, and trust, not hours logged.

items.title: AI-native delivery
items.body: AI is embedded in how we work: our operating model, our tooling, our delivery rhythm. AI-native execution plus human judgment means one team ships more work in parallel, with the same people owning it throughout.

items.title: One team, flexible capacity
items.body: We collaborate in person often, because shared time strengthens alignment, trust, and execution. We believe in remote work, but not remote-first. Our model is remote-augmented: anchored by in-person collaboration, extended by flexibility.

standard.body: High standards are mutual. We ask a lot of our team, and our team should expect just as much from Viewnear.

meaning.eyebrow: What it means for the team
meaning.title: A better model is a better place to work

items.title: Growth
items.body: Meaningful work that expands learning, business context, and technical range.

items.title: Focus
items.body: Less repetitive work, more time on judgment, delivery, and leadership.

items.title: Balance
items.body: Great work over the long run requires recovery. Time off is flexible (no fixed cap) provided outcomes stay strong and teams stay covered.

items.title: Rewards
items.body: Stronger economics fund better compensation, bonuses, and benefits.

items.title: Pride
items.body: Hard problems, real ownership, and work worth putting a name on.

benefits.title: We reinvest in the team
benefits.intro: Better outcomes create stronger economics, and we put those economics back into the people who deliver them. Healthcare, dental, emotional wellness, and more.

standApart.title: A win for one is a win for all
standApart.intro: Stronger economics build a stronger team, and a stronger team delivers better outcomes. It's a flywheel, and everyone shares in it.
items: Collaboration is real: teams work together in person and remotely, with shared accountability for outcomes.
